# HTTP API reference

The browser server (`src-tauri/src/web/`) exposes these endpoints. All are under `/api`. `POST`/`DELETE` requests need the header `x-janus-request: 1` and a same-origin `Origin`. Sessions use an HttpOnly cookie. Errors are `{ "error": kind, "message": text }` with kinds `unauthorized` (401), `validation` (400), `not_found` (404), `forbidden` (403) and `internal` (500).

| Method | Path | Handler | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/auth/status` | `status` | Public: what the sign-in page needs before anyone has typed anything. |
| POST | `/api/auth/register` | `register` | Creates an account and signs it in. The first account becomes the admin; later ones need signup to be open. Returns the one-time recovery key. |
| POST | `/api/auth/login` | `login` | Checks the passphrase and starts a session (a 30-day or a short one). Wrong attempts are rate-limited per address and per account. |
| POST | `/api/auth/logout` | `logout` | Ends the current session and clears the cookie. |
| POST | `/api/auth/reset` | `reset` | Sets a new passphrase from the recovery key, signs other sessions out, and returns a fresh recovery key. |
| GET | `/api/auth/me` | `me` | The signed-in account. |
| POST | `/api/auth/change-passphrase` | `change_passphrase` | Changes the passphrase; other sessions are signed out. |
| GET | `/api/auth/sessions` | `list_sessions` | The account's signed-in devices, marking the current one. |
| DELETE | `/api/auth/sessions/{id}` | `revoke_session` | Signs one of the account's devices out. |
| POST | `/api/rpc/{name}` | `handle` | `POST /api/rpc/{name}` |
| GET | `/api/events` | `stream` | `GET /api/events`: the signed-in account's events as a Server-Sent Events stream. |
| GET | `/api/files/{*path}` | `get_file` | `GET /api/files/{*path}` |
| POST | `/api/upload/attachment` | `upload_attachment` | `POST /api/upload/attachment?ext=png`: the raw image bytes as the body. |
| POST | `/api/upload/character-card` | `upload_character_card` | `POST /api/upload/character-card`: a Character Card V2 PNG as the body. |
| POST | `/api/upload/persona-card` | `upload_persona_card` | `POST /api/upload/persona-card`: a Character Card V2 PNG as the body. |
| POST | `/api/upload/portrait/{character_id}` | `upload_portrait` | `POST /api/upload/portrait/{character_id}`: the raw image bytes as the body. |
